## check subjects for exclusion and  fit the subject level model for each subject:

```{r}
dd = df %>% 
  mutate(subject = as.numeric(as.factor(subject))) %>% 
  filter(Trialtype == "Main", scale == "conf") %>% 
    filter(
  abs(X) < case_when(
    ID == "RDM_reportz_sub001.csv" ~ 0.6,
    ID == "RDM_reportz_sub010.csv" ~ 0.4,
    TRUE ~ Inf
  )) %>% 
  group_by(subject) %>% 
  mutate(
    trial_n = 1:n(), n_trials = n()
  ) %>% 
  ungroup() %>% 
  mutate(
    across(-c("ID","subject"),
      ~ ifelse(
        ID == "RDM_reportz_sub030.csv" & trial_n > (n_trials - 36),
        NA,
        .
      )
    )
  ) 


exclusions_correct = dd %>% group_by(ID) %>% summarize(n = sum(Correct)/n()) %>% filter(n < 0.60)

exclusions_ntrials = dd %>% 
  select(interTrial.interval, interval,coherence,X,Correct,Y,RT,Confidence,ID) %>% 
    mutate(
    no_response = is.na(Correct) |
                  is.na(Confidence) |
                  is.na(RT) |
                  RT < 0.150) %>% 
  group_by(ID) %>%
  summarize(noresp_rate = mean(no_response)) %>%
  filter(noresp_rate > 0.3)

n_excluded_correctness = length(unique(exclusions_correct$ID))
n_excluded_trials = length(unique(exclusions_ntrials$ID))

n_excluded = length(unique(c(exclusions_correct$ID, exclusions_ntrials$ID)))

dd = dd %>% filter(!ID %in% c(exclusions_correct$ID, exclusions_ntrials$ID)) %>% drop_na()

dd_by_subj <- split(dd, dd$ID)
```


```{r, message=F, error=F, warning=F}
plots = plot_beh_data(dd, 12, F)

plots

```



```{r}
if(length(list.files(here::here("Sequential sampling","Fits","Single Subject"))) == length(dd_by_subj)){
  
  models = list.files(here::here("Sequential sampling","Fits","Single Subject"), full.names = T)
  fits = list()
  for(model in models[1:length(models)]){
    fit = readRDS(model)
    paths = str_split(model, "/")[[1]]
    name = paths[length(paths)]
    
    fits[[str_remove(str_remove(name,".rds"),"fit_")]] = fit  
  }
  
}else{
  fits <- lapply(dd_by_subj, function(d) {
  fit_model_ss(d)})
}
```


```{r}
if(length(list.files(here::here("Sequential sampling","Fits","Single Subject nolapse"))) == length(dd_by_subj)){
```

# bayes factors:

```{r}
bf_sigmam = get_bf(post = as.numeric(as_draws_df(fit$draws("gm[7]")) %>% .$`gm[7]`),prior = rnorm(4000,0,0.5))
bf_metabias = get_bf(post = as.numeric(as_draws_df(fit$draws("gm[8]")) %>% .$`gm[8]`),prior = rnorm(4000,0,0.5))

Bayesfactor_data = data.frame(BF = bf_sigmam, subjects = length(dd_by_subj))

hierarchical_diagnostics_saved = list(hierarchical_diagnostics[[1]],hierarchical_diagnostics[[4]],hierarchical_diagnostics[[6]])

Seq_samp = list(n_excluded_correctness,n_excluded_trials,n_excluded,hierarchical_diagnostics_saved,Bayesfactor_data)

saveRDS(Seq_samp, here::here("Preregistration","Results","SS",paste0("SS_",length(dd_by_subj),".rds")))

```

```{r,fig.height=12, fig.width=18}
models = list.files(here::here("Sequential sampling","Fits","allmodels"), full.names = T)

df  = data.frame()

for (model in models){
  print(model)
  fit = readRDS(model)

  type = str_extract(model, "standard|narrow|super_narrow|wide")
  subs = str_extract(model, "(?<=nolapse_)\\d+")
  
  if(type == "standard"){
    bf_sigmam = get_bf(post = as.numeric(as_draws_df(fit$draws("gm[7]")) %>% .$`gm[7]`),prior = rnorm(4000,0,0.5))
    bf_metabias = get_bf(post = as.numeric(as_draws_df(fit$draws("gm[8]")) %>% .$`gm[8]`),prior = rnorm(4000,0,0.5))
    
    Bayesfactor_data = data.frame(variable = c("sigmam_beta","metabias_beta"),BF = c(bf_sigmam,bf_metabias), subs = subs)

  }else if(type == "narrow"){
    bf_sigmam = get_bf(post = as.numeric(as_draws_df(fit$draws("gm[7]")) %>% .$`gm[7]`),prior = rnorm(4000,0,0.25))
    bf_metabias = get_bf(post = as.numeric(as_draws_df(fit$draws("gm[8]")) %>% .$`gm[8]`),prior = rnorm(4000,0,0.25))
    
    Bayesfactor_data = data.frame(variable = c("sigmam_beta","metabias_beta"),BF = c(bf_sigmam,bf_metabias), subs = subs)

  }else if(type == "super_narrow"){
    bf_sigmam = get_bf(post = as.numeric(as_draws_df(fit$draws("gm[7]")) %>% .$`gm[7]`),prior = rnorm(4000,0,0.05))
    bf_metabias = get_bf(post = as.numeric(as_draws_df(fit$draws("gm[8]")) %>% .$`gm[8]`),prior = rnorm(4000,0,0.05))
    
    Bayesfactor_data = data.frame(variable = c("sigmam_beta","metabias_beta"),BF = c(bf_sigmam,bf_metabias), subs = subs)

  }else if(type == "wide"){
    bf_sigmam = get_bf(post = as.numeric(as_draws_df(fit$draws("gm[7]")) %>% .$`gm[7]`),prior = rnorm(4000,0,1))
    bf_metabias = get_bf(post = as.numeric(as_draws_df(fit$draws("gm[8]")) %>% .$`gm[8]`),prior = rnorm(4000,0,1))
    
    Bayesfactor_data = data.frame(variable = c("sigmam_beta","metabias_beta"),BF = c(bf_sigmam,bf_metabias), subs = subs)

  }
  
  groupmeans = fit$summary("gm") %>% 
    mutate(variable = c("beta","sigma_e","sigma_k","sigma_m","meta_bias","conf_prec","sigmam_beta","metabias_beta"),
           subs = subs) %>% mutate(type = type)

  groupmeans = full_join(groupmeans,Bayesfactor_data)
  
  df = rbind(df,groupmeans)  
  
}


estimates = df %>% filter(variable %in% c("sigmam_beta","metabias_beta")) %>% 
  ggplot(aes(x = as.numeric(subs), y = mean, ymin = q5, ymax = q95, col = type))+
  geom_pointrange(position = position_dodge(width = 1))+
  theme_classic(base_size = 16)+
  facet_wrap(~variable)

ggsave(here::here("Sequential sampling" , "figures","estimates_v2.png"),estimates, dpi = 300, width = 14, height = 10)

Bayesfactors =  df %>% filter(variable %in% c("sigmam_beta","metabias_beta")) %>% 
  select(subs,BF,type, variable) %>% 
    group_by(type, variable) %>%
  group_modify(~ add_row(.x, subs = "0", BF = 1)) %>%
  ungroup() %>% 
  ggplot(aes(x = as.numeric(subs), y = log(BF), col = type))+
  geom_line()+
  geom_point()+
  theme_classic(base_size = 16)+
   labs(y = "Log(BF)", x = "N_subjects")+
  geom_hline(yintercept = c(log(1/30),log(30)), linetype = 2)+
  scale_y_continuous(breaks = c(round(log(1/30),2),0,round(log(30),2)))+
  scale_x_continuous(limits = c(0,50), breaks = seq(0,50,by = 10), labels = seq(0,50,by = 10))+
  facet_wrap(~variable)

ggsave(here::here("Sequential sampling" , "figures","Bayesfactors_v2.png"),Bayesfactors, dpi = 300, width = 14, height = 10)

```
